name: Hudaco Industries Limited
summary: Hudaco Industries Limited imports and distributes automotive, industrial, and electronic consumable products in South Africa and internationally. It operates in two segments, Consumer-Related Products and Engineering Consumables. The Consumer-Related Products segment distributes clutch kits, automotive ignition leads, oil and hydraulic seals, wheels, brake and clutch hydraulics, mountings, bushes, hydraulic repair kits, cylinders, hoses, CV joints, wheel hubs, suspension components, and vehicle components to the automotive and industrial after-market; batteries, chargers, and related battery management equipment, as well as battery bays; power tools, marine engines, survey instruments, and f…
